name: mandate
description: The market-maker deal as an onchain program (1inch Aqua + SwapVM + Uniswap v4).

scripts.contracts:test: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; cd contracts && forge test
scripts.generate: pnpm contracts:build && cd contracts && RUST_LOG=error forge script script/GenerateSdkFixtures.s.sol:GenerateSdkFixtures --quiet && cd .. && node scripts/generate.ts
scripts.generate:check: pnpm contracts:build && cd contracts && SDK_FIXTURES_CHECK=true RUST_LOG=error forge script script/GenerateSdkFixtures.s.sol:GenerateSdkFixtures --quiet && cd .. && node scripts/generate.ts --check
scripts.base:worker: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; export INDEXER_CHAIN_ID=8453 INDEXER_RPC_URL="$BASE_INDEXER_RPC_URL" DATABASE_URL="$BASE_DATABASE_URL" INDEXER_CONFIRMATIONS=2 INDEXER_SNAPSHOT_CONCURRENCY=2 API_PORT=8788 && cd apps/indexer && node src/worker.ts
scripts.base:server: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; export INDEXER_CHAIN_ID=8453 INDEXER_RPC_URL="$BASE_INDEXER_RPC_URL" DATABASE_URL="$BASE_DATABASE_URL" INDEXER_CONFIRMATIONS=2 INDEXER_SNAPSHOT_CONCURRENCY=2 API_PORT=8788 && cd apps/indexer && node src/server.ts
scripts.base:fills: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; cd contracts && forge script script/live/LiveFills.s.sol --rpc-url "$BASE_RPC_URL"
